discussion:
# Principle

Suitable and sufficient personnel and resources are identified, acquired and maintained in support of cyber security activities.

# Indicators of Good Practice

Not effective:
- No review of cyber security resourcing has been conducted.
- Resourcing has not been reassessed following significant organisational or threat landscape changes.

Partially effective:
- A review has been conducted but did not reference current threat trends, cyber security incident outcomes, or organisational changes.
- Review outcomes have identified required adjustments, but those adjustments have not been made.

Fully effective:
- A resourcing review has been completed within the review period defined by the organisation.
- The review references current threat trends, cyber security incident outcomes and organisational changes.
- Documented review outcomes include resourcing adjustments that are implemented within timeframes defined by the organisation, or formally risk accepted by an appropriate authority.
title: Periodically review cyber security resourcing against cyber threat trends, cyber security incident outcomes and organisational changes.
